evidence_text: Darden Restaurants, Inc. is a full-service restaurant company headquartered at 1000 Darden Center Drive, Orlando, Florida. Its portfolio includes Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Yard House, Ruth's Chris Steak House, Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, The Capital Grille, Chuy's, Seasons 52, Eddie V's, Bahama Breeze, and The Capital Burger. As of May 31, 2026, Darden owned and operated 2,202 U.S. restaurants and had 167 franchised restaurants operated by independent third parties outside the United States and in the U.S.
source_title: Darden Restaurants, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended May 31, 2026
limitations: Counts are as of May 31, 2026; does not combine company-operated, franchised, and contractually operated locations into one ownership category.

evidence_text: Rick Cardenas is Darden Restaurants' President and Chief Executive Officer; he assumed the role on May 30, 2022. Darden's current executive leadership page also lists Chris Chang as Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer and Raj Vennam as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
limitations: Leadership roster is current at research time and may change.

evidence_text: Darden's FY2026 Form 10-K says it continued a multi-year effort to implement technology platforms for digital guest and team-member engagement, marketing and analytics, and improved online/mobile ordering and payment across its brands. The filing describes a shared secure digital platform, brand mobile applications, centrally coordinated restaurant hardware/software support from its Orlando Restaurant Support Center, a company data center, and use of public cloud where appropriate. It does not identify POS, payment processing, or named platform vendors.
source_title: Darden Restaurants, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended May 31, 2026
limitations: Company-level architecture only; no named POS, KDS, payment processor, loyalty platform, or specific cloud provider established.

evidence_text: For fiscal 2027 Q1 ended August 30, 2026, Darden reported sales of $3.2 billion, up 5.1%; blended same-restaurant sales increased 3.1% on its fiscal calendar basis (3.2% comparable calendar). It reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook, including diluted EPS from continuing operations of $11.10-$11.35.
source_title: Darden Reports Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results and Reaffirms Outlook
limitations: Same-restaurant sales are affected by Darden's disclosed 53-week-to-52-week fiscal calendar shift; figures distinguish fiscal-calendar and comparable-calendar bases.
